svg.title: Ionisation loss in liquid hydrogen against 1/beta^2
svg.desc: Bethe-Bloch mean energy loss relative to its minimum against beta gamma, compared with the clamped 1/beta^2 of the chamber view; and the loss against momentum for pion, kaon and proton.
svg.text: Ionisation in liquid hydrogen: what 1/beta^2 keeps and what it drops
Bethe formula without density correction. Minimum ionisation here: 4.06 MeV cm^2/g at beta gamma = 3.5, 0.288 MeV/cm in liquid hydrogen.
At fixed momentum, heavier means denser
